text:
# listing.restriction

TL;DR:
- listing.restriction is the content handling level of the listing.

What it means:
- listing.restriction tells the agent how carefully the listing should be treated in product and visibility terms.
- Use the enum resource for exact value meanings: zbav://mcp/schema/enum/listing-restriction.

Agent hint:
- Treat stronger restriction levels as real product constraints, not cosmetic labels.
